data.name: Justinian
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Iustinianus, derived from the Greek name Ioustinianos, meaning 'righteous, just, rule'. This name was borne by several emperors of the Eastern Roman Empire, including the renowned Emperor Justinian I (482-565 AD), who is known for his legal reforms and military conquests.
